claims.text: In Back to the Future (1985), the DeLorean time machine travels in time when it reaches 88 miles per hour.
The film's time-travel speed is not 55, 100 or 121 miles per hour.
88 miles per hour is about 142 km/h.
The time machine needs 1.21 gigawatts of power, which Doc Brown takes from a lightning strike in the film's climax.
